clips.title: The story
paras: At the Windshear dig sites, kobolds smelt Smoky Iron Ingots from ore they pull from the Stonetalon Mountains. Orcish armorers prize the bars as raw material for sturdy mail gear for Horde warriors.

Kobolds smelt Smoky Iron Ingots in the Windshear Crag tunnels of the Stonetalon Mountains. They dig ore from the rocky slopes and heat it over crude, smoking fires. Residue and charcoal cling to the bars, but the metal remains dense and strong.

Thun'grim Firegaze, a near-blind orc armorer, works from a rugged camp overlooking the Barrens. He asks for these ingots to make armor for proven Horde warriors. Alongside refined iron bars, powdered azurite, and volatile phlogiston, the smoky metal forms a resilient core for Brutal Hauberks.
